pending_software_example.scope: Generated software-only tables, not experimental data.
pending_software_example.recipe: For integer i=0..100, energy=7000+i, detector_a=1+0.1*sin(i/10), detector_b=2+0.2*cos(i/10), printed to 6 decimal places. The header names energy/detector_a/detector_b without declaring units, so the batch review requests confirmation.

scientific_scope: Workflow documentation. Public experimental Cu for processing and path fitting; two separate acquisitions for Series, not a controlled temperature comparison. PCA/MCR are saved noise-free synthetic-mixture tests, not unique chemical identification. No private original project is published.
observations: Stored Cu mutrans imported with 408 points and eV axis. Polynomial/MBACK switched in Normalize; Cu/K automatically suggested. Fit overlay and single AUTOBK spline inspected.
Fourier k max set to 12 inverse angstrom. Wavelet displays linked R and k spectra with settings in the Transform sidebar.
Assistant opened alongside Groups and Parameters. Model and Access menus inspected without sending a prompt or changing permissions.

Cu ReFEFF: 8 angstrom cluster, 62 computed paths, first single-scattering path selected, four free variables. Fit k=2..12, R=1..3, weight 2, noise scale 1. Eight optimizer iterations, R-factor displayed 0.00330. No unique-structure claim.
Portable save options and SVG publication preview inspected. Separate temporary projects retained locally.

Series: two public Cu measurements, Flat maximum 0..30 eV, wavelet integral k=4..10 inverse angstrom and R=1..3 angstrom. Both frames calculated. Difference reference 1 retained while Right selected frame 2.

Saved 0.2.9 PCA/MCR results reopened. PCA linear Error vs count shown; MCR components compared with marked references. Add to Groups created three further components, then a component was processed in Transform.
LCF rerun with All frames on the 100-mixture scan and three marked standards. Coefficient trend populated; clicked heatmap and pressed Right, selecting frame 52.
Athena/Larch json_unzipped.prj preview showed all four checked records and Import 4 spectra. Import completed.
Pending synthetic tables: Skip .dat removed two pending entries while notes.txt remained. Undo skip restored both entries. Original files unchanged.
QAS Mo: all three detected signals remained selected while Reference was previewed as ln(it/ir). EX3: stored mu preview and original header expanded.
